title: Bla's Creations
description: All of my hats and other models thrown into one resource pack.
body:
This is a bunch of hats, weapons and other things I've made for 1.21.11 Java.
To get the different models rename;

Carved Pumpkin: Top Hat, Jellie Head Sit, Jellie Shoulder, Jellie Head Rest, Tall Hat, Beige Headphones, Black Headphones, Basil Crown, or Flower Crown.

Diamond, Iron or Netherite Sword: Sickle

Iron, Diamond or Netherite Spear: Ice Staff

Bundle: Potion Bag, Potion Bag Filled
